text:
jess_support: FYI — customer Acme Corp (org_id: org_87) reports mismatch between daily usage chart and CSV export for 2025-08-15. Chart (org timezone = America/Chicago) shows 12,345 tokens; CSV total = 11,780. They attached screenshot and CSV snippet.

mike_billing: can you paste the org id + link to the org settings row?

jess_support: org_87, console shows Timezone: America/Chicago (screenshot). Export CSV first timestamp column looks like ISO Z (e.g. 2025-08-15T00:00:00Z). Customer says export is being cut at UTC midnight.

sophie_prod: assigning to eng-platform and tagging @devon_sre — do our export jobs respect org timezones?

devon_sre: quick look at export job logs: default TZ is UTC unless overridden. Relevant env: EXPORT_DAY_TRUNC=UTC. Query used in job: 
```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', events.timestamp) as day_utc, sum(tokens)
FROM events
WHERE organization_id = 'org_87'
GROUP BY day_utc;
```
That will bucket by UTC day.

analytics_bot: job "daily-usage-export" v3.2.1 ran on node-12 at 2025-08-16T03:00:01Z and used timezone=UTC (detected from env).

jess_support: repro steps provided by customer: 1) Console -> Organization -> Timezone = America/Chicago 2) View Usage -> pick 2025-08-15 -> totals on chart 3) Click CSV Export -> download -> totals in CSV correspond to 2025-08-15 UTC slice not America/Chicago slice. Sample CSV row they sent: 
```
2025-08-15T00:00:00Z,11780
```

mike_billing: this is impacting billing reconciliation for an enterprise customer (dedicated commitment). We should prioritise.

devon_sre: quick mitigation: the export CLI supports a --tz flag. UI currently does not propagate org timezone to the job payload. Workaround for support: run export with `./exporter --org org_87 --date 2025-08-15 --tz "America/Chicago"` and attach CSV to customer.

sophie_prod: devon, can you open a PR to make the UI add timezone to the export payload and make the job default to org timezone when present? Add unit tests for timezone-aware truncation.

devon_sre: PR #4729 opened. Changes: use parameterized org_tz and change SQL to: 
```sql
SELECT date_trunc('day', (events.timestamp AT TIME ZONE %(org_tz)s)) AS local_day, sum(tokens)
FROM events
WHERE organization_id = %(org_id)s
GROUP BY local_day;
```
Also updates CSV header to include local_day in ISO local midnight. Rolling to staging in ~10m for canary.

ops_oncall: scheduled canary window at 2025-08-17T01:00Z, will watch export latencies and any error spikes.

jess_support: I'll reply to the customer with the workaround and say we're rolling a fix to staging, ETA ~48h. Thanks. :thumbsup:

mike_billing: set severity to high and flag customer success for reconciliation assistance.

jess_support: ticket #CS-12345 updated with notes and workaround command. Will follow up when staging deploy is green. :eyes:
